Name: Mini Ostrich - Dinosaur Replacer
Author: chlpper
Description:
Now introducing Mini Ostriches that live along side your chickens, ducks, etc. in your coop!
This mod replaces the dinosaur and dinosaur egg files so that they look like tiny ostriches!

Join my Discord to follow my mod updates: [url=https://discord.gg/jkgbQStGX8]https://discord.gg/jkgbQStGX8[/url]﻿

[b]Update Post: March 4th, 2021[/b]
Hello!
I've edited the sprites colours to be a bit more vibrant to match Stardew Valley's style as well as tweaked the animations for the sprites, most importantly the sleeping and eating animations so that they look more proper.

This mod also replaces the Dinosaur Eggs with Mini Ostrich Eggs and Dinosaur Mayonnaise with Mini Ostrich Mayo.

[b]Content Patcher Installation Instructions[/b]
[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download "Content Patcher - Scoot Duck Replacer
[*]Extract "[CP] Mini Ostrich Dino Replacer by CHlPPER" zip file
[*]Move the new folder to programfiles> steam> steamapps> common> stardew valley> mods
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and then you're done!
[/list]
